title: Starojoss Destranoth
dek: Star writes down the strange parts of a story before anyone can make them tidier than they were.

facts.Recorded at: The Gate and road to Pristinia

sources: Gate chronicle · selected arrival and welcome scenes; January 2024–September 2026 posting records
body:
A threshold and a guide

Star arrives in the Gate clearing and meets Vessalia, who excitedly identifies her as her first Gate pick-up. Star introduces herself as Starojoss Destranoth, with Star as the easier name. She says she was studying at a university before the crossing.

Keeping the strange bits

Star says she likes writing down stories, especially the parts people leave out. Vessalia points her toward the academy, scroll library, quest board and Pilgrim’s Hearth. Star respects her guide’s decision not to discuss every detail of a difficult harpy encounter.

A commitment without false certainty

When Vessalia tells her to consider the people of her former world dead, Star refuses to accept that conclusion simply because someone says it on a road. She does promise not to help destroy Fenumion. Vessalia apologises and reframes her appeal around protecting both worlds; Star agrees to help. No destruction of Star’s home is established.

Names in a notebook

At the tavern threshold, Star records Pristinia, Prima, Pilgrim’s Hearth, Herb and Vessalia. She calls the welcome informative in a slightly alarming way, then goes inside. Her journey ends this scene with shelter and a first account, not a settled faction allegiance.
